settings.hero_alt: Eight plushes gathered around a miniature wooden meeting table in a styled boardroom scene.
settings.hero_body: A whole collection of very persuasive little faces. The committee has one request: take everyone home.
settings.story_body: Your desk is appealing the decision. Either way, all eight are coming home. The final seating arrangement is up to you.
settings.size_body: Put them on your desk. Let them oversee the day.
settings.proof_body: Stitched smiles, colorful hoods and tiny brown paws. You can see how the vote went.
settings.final_body: One complete eight-plush collection. Motion carried. $160.
settings.collection_body: Eight separate plushes. Eight distinct costumes. Every member pictured is included in your set.
